_comment: Mutations that reopen the FOUR gaps the review panel raised in the
session-leak guard, plus the follow-up holes the panel's second round
found. Each one takes the guard (or the session release) back to the
broken shape; every one of them must be KILLED by
tests/test_db_session_guard.py.
GAP 1 (SCOPE)  - A1 stops the guard scanning `api/`; A2 stops it scanning
the repo root.
GAP 2 (SHAPE)  - A3 removes the `await anext(...)` acquisition rule; A4
removes the assign-then-iterate form; A5 removes the
inline `await anext(factory())` form; A11 removes the
`asend` form; A12 removes the attribute-bound generator;
A13 removes the walrus binding; A14 stops matching a
factory called with an argument.
GAP 3 (NAMES)  - A6 puts the factory NAME list back; A7 lets a close in
one function hide a leak in another; A9 writes the leak
again with a RENAMED factory - the rename mutant; A10
lets a close that may never run hide a leak.
GAP 4 (SWALLOW) - A8 swallows the close failure again.
A15 makes the guard swallow a file it cannot parse.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/db_session_guard.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.
